resources.string: Type or select text to fix
Active in background. Tap floating toggle to fix text.
Enables TypeFix AI floating button to read and replace text in your active keyboard without sending data online.
Listening offline… Tap Finish when done
Offline voice needs Android 12+ and an installed on-device speech recognizer/language.
Microphone access is needed for voice typing. Tap Speak again after granting access.

TypeFix uses your microphone only after you tap Speak. Recognition stays on your device. No recording is saved by TypeFix. Return to your usual keyboard and tap the floating Speak after allowing access.
Voice text inserted. Tap Fix for corrections.
Could not recognize speech. Check your offline language pack and try again.
No speech detected. Tap Speak to try again.
Voice typing cancelled because the editor changed.
Review your transcript, then tap Insert text or Cancel.
The editor changed. Please try again.
This editor does not support safe preview insertion.

Shows a microphone when a keyboard is visible. Only when you tap Speak, reads the focused non-password field and inserts your transcript there. Does not store field contents or use the clipboard. You can disable access in Android Settings.
Allow notifications to see the microphone session notice in your notification drawer. This is optional; denying it does not grant or revoke microphone access.
Microphone permission was denied. You can enable Microphone under Permissions in TypeFix app settings. Return to your keyboard and tap Speak afterward.
Notifications are disabled. You can enable them in TypeFix app settings. This permission is optional for voice typing.
Android blocked microphone startup. Open TypeFix, check microphone access, then try again.
